phase: 6 -- owned data first: every Atlas-owned artifact that could already know Denver, measured before new acquisition
headline: ZERO owned identities in this market's admitted geography. Every committed market graph was scanned and none of the 35 live markets holds a node in any of the 106 admitted postal codes -- this is the first Colorado market.
a_brand_prefix_is_not_a_market: Marriott's DEN prefix covers the Denver metro -- and Fort Collins, Winter Park and Parker -- and its VBO prefix Boulder / Longmont; neither decides membership. A route carries no postal code, so every route is a LEAD with a PRESUMED disposition read off the brand's own slug.

live_identity_names.what_it_is: The normalised canonical name of every identity every registered market publishes. No live market owns a Colorado premises, so a Denver row can collide with a live market ONLY by name; the census holds any Denver row whose own normalised name is already published elsewhere.

cross_market_name_collision_guard.what_this_order_does_about_it: MEASURES it and hands the strings to the census reconciliation as a named guard, which HOLDS rather than silently drops any hit. This order does NOT edit the shared exclusion file.

provider_history.pay_once_rule: Every URL this order is about to buy is checked against these ledgers first.
provider_history.refusals_are_treated_as_stale: A prior refusal ages in days and is re-probed, never inherited.
